title: Solar Farm — Overview
description: Site power, performance ratio, availability and the alert feed. Reads through the InfluxDB 3 datasource over Flight SQL.

panels.title: Site power
panels.description: Latest AC output across all inverters. ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1, which reads the tail of the window rather than scanning the whole history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "total_ac_power_w" FROM site_rollup WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Performance ratio
panels.description: Temperature-corrected AC/POA ratio. Below 0.7 for a sustained period is the performance_ratio_low alert.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "pr_ratio" FROM site_rollup WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "daily_yield_kwh" FROM site_rollup WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Inverters online
panels.description: 4 is the full fleet. Below it, the inverters_missing alert fires.

targets.rawSql: SELECT "inverters_online" AS online, "strings_online" AS strings FROM site_rollup WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: AC power — all inverters
panels.description: One series per inverter, binned to 5 minutes. Overlapping lines are normal when the fleet is balanced. The time picker drives the window via $__timeFilter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', time) AS time, inverter_id, AVG("ac_power_w") AS "ac power" FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, inverter_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GHI and air temperature
panels.description: Irradiance drives output; a clear multi-day drop with no weather change is the sensor_drift fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', time) AS time, AVG("ghi") AS "GHI" FROM weather_station WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', time) AS time, AVG("air_temp_c") AS "air temp" FROM weather_station WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: String balance per inverter
panels.description: Spread between the strongest and weakest string. Normal is under 5%; a genuinely degrading string exceeds 20%. The inner query groups by time as well as inverter because MAX and MIN over the whole window would just compare the fleet's overall peaks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT inverter_id, ROUND(MAX(imbalance), 4) AS "imbalance" FROM (SELECT time, inverter_id, (MAX("dc_power_w") - MIN("dc_power_w")) / NULLIF(MAX("dc_power_w"), 0) AS imbalance FROM string_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time, inverter_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT string_id) >= 3) GROUP BY inverter_id ORDER BY "imbalance" DESC

panels.title: Alert feed
panels.description: Every alert transition, written by the API rule engine and the simulator. Resolutions carry a _RESOLVED suffix at info severity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, severity, source, code, message FROM events WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
